questions.q: A body of weight $W$ is lifted through a height $h$ by application of force $F$ over a time $\Delta t$ using a lever. Choose the correct option.
options: When $W$ is kept between the fulcrum and $F$, it needs a force greater than $W$ to lift it by $h$.
If the fulcrum is between $W$ and $F$, the mechanical advantage is always greater than when it is kept at any one end of the lever.
If $F$ is applied at a point on the lever between the fulcrum and $W$, then the body will be lifted by maximum distance.
Irrespective of the position of the fulcrum, $F$ must always be directed in the direction of the lift.
